messages.message: ### Step 2: Morphosyntactic Requirement Definition Goal: For Japanese, specify per-token morphosyntax needed to realize the Step 1 Interpretation Lock. Output: ONE Markdown table only (no prose). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Requirement] In [Target Requirement]: make comparative ordering+degree explicit and add a 1-line literal back-translation check.

| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Requirement | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------| | **Tant'** | Intensifier of “amara” | Use adverb **とても** (very) before the adjective; literal check: *“とても苦い”* → “so bitter”. | | **è** | Copular link (subject = implicit “it”) | Insert copula **だ** after the predicate adjective; literal check: *“苦いだ”* → “is bitter”. | | **amara** | Predicate adjective “bitter” | Render as adjective **苦い**; literal check: *“苦い”* → “bitter”. | | **che** | Comparative subordinator introducing the clause “poco è più morte” | Mark the start of a comparative clause with **ほど** or **より**; literal check: *“…ほど”* → “so … that”. | | **poco** | Degree adverb “little”, indicating a slight excess | Translate as **ほんの少しだけ** placed before the comparative marker; literal check: *“ほんの少しだけ”* → “only a little”. | | **è** (in comparative clause) | Copular verb inside the comparative clause | Use copula **だ** after the adjective in the comparative clause; literal check: *“苦いだ”* → “is bitter”. | | **più** | Comparative adverb “more” (death > bitterness) | Express the comparative with **より** (than) and place **ほんの少しだけ** before the adjective to show slightness: **死よりほんの少しだけ苦い**. Literal check: *“死よりほんの少しだけ苦い”* → “death is only a little more bitter”. | | **morte** | Noun “death”, the term being compared | Render as **死**; literal check: *“死”* → “death”. | | **ma** | Coordinating conjunction “but” | Use **しかし** or **だが** to connect clauses; literal check: *“しかし”* → “but”. | | **per** | Preposition marking purpose | Translate as **ために** (in order to) preceding the infinitive verb; literal check: *“…するために”* → “in order to”. | | **trattar** | Infinitive “to treat / discuss” | Use the verb **論じる** in its infinitive form **論じる**; literal check: *“論じる”* → “to treat”. | | **del** | Prepositional phrase “of the” linking verb to object | Render as **の** after the verb to mark the object; literal check: *“論じるの”* → “to treat of”. | | **ben** | Noun “good” (object of discussion) | Translate as **善** or **良いこと**; literal check: *“善”* → “good”. | | **ch'** | Relative pronoun “that” introducing clause “i' vi trovai” | Use **こと** or **の** to nominalize the relative clause; literal check: *“…こと”* → “that”. | | **i'** | Subject pronoun “I” | Insert **私** as the subject; literal check: *“私が”* → “I”. | | **vi** | Locative adverb “there” | Render as **そこ** or **そこで**; literal check: *“そこ”* → “there”. | | **trovai** | Past tense “found” (passato remoto) | Use past form **見つけた**; literal check: *“見つけた”* → “found”. | | **dirò** | Future tense “I will tell” | Use future‑like construction **言うだろう** or **言います** with future nuance; literal check: *“言います”* → “I will tell”. | | **de** | Prepositional phrase “of the” introducing “l'altre cose” | Render as **の** linking to the noun phrase; literal check: *“…の”* → “of the”. | | **l'altre** | Determiner “the other” | Translate as **他の**; literal check: *“他の”* → “other”. | | **cose** | Noun “things” (object of “dirò”) | Render as **もの**; literal check: *“もの”* → “things”. | | **ch'** (second occurrence) | Relative pronoun “that” introducing clause “i' v'ho scorte” | Use **こと** or **の** to nominalize; literal check: *“…こと”* → “that”. | | **i'** (second) | Subject pronoun “I” | Insert **私**; literal check: *“私が”* → “I”. | | **v'** | Locative adverb “there” | Render as **そこ** or **そこで**; literal check: *“そこ”* → “there”. | | **ho** | Auxiliary “have” for perfect | Use **ている** construction with the main verb; literal check: *“見ている”* → “have seen”. | | **scorte** | Past participle “seen” (from *scorgere*) | Translate as **見た** (or **見ていた** for perfect); literal check: *“見た”* → “seen”. |

### Step 3: Pre-assembled Lexical Inventory Output: bullet list only; one line per source line. Format: - Line <ID>: <Phrase 1> / <Phrase 2> / <Phrase 3> Rules: each phrase is directly placeable (no glue-only fragments) and covers the line’s main predicate + required linkage. Hook: satisfy Step 2 requirements for that line (incl. back-translation checks). Comparatives: preserve ordering (A>B ⇔ B<A is OK) and degree; at least one phrase must make both recoverable. No punctuation inside phrases; keep phrases short; no newlines.

- Line 7: 死はほんの少しだけ苦さが上回る / それほど苦くはないが死は少し上回る / 死がほんの少しだけ苦さを超える - Line 8: しかしそこで見つけた善を論じるために / しかしそこで見つけた善について語るために / しかしそこで見つけた善を語る目的で - Line 9: 私はそこで見た他のものについて語るだろう / 私はそこで見た他のものを語るつもりだ / 私はそこで見た他のものについて語ります

### Step 4: Slot-Based Syntactic Assembly Task: Assemble Step3 phrases into Japanese lines; keep the same number of lines. Use Step3 phrases as contiguous substrings; reorder within line as needed. Allowed edits: insert only function-words/morphology for grammatical joining; no new content words. Punctuation: copy only end punctuation to line end; add no internal punctuation. Comparatives: preserve ordering+degree; make compared entities explicit if otherwise ambiguous. Output per source line (labels verbatim): Source Line: <copy exact source line> Line Inventory: - <copy the phrases you chose from Step 3 for this line> Assembly Notes: - If you inserted any function-words/morphology for joining, list them briefly. Target Text: <assembled target line> If you forgot a necessary Step3 phrase: re-insert it (no new content words).

**Source Line:** 7 Tant' è amara che poco è più morte;
**Line Inventory:** - 死はほんの少しだけ苦さが上回る
**Assembly Notes:** - Added end‑punctuation “;” to match source. No other function words needed.
**Target Text:** 死はほんの少しだけ苦さが上回る;
**Source Line:** 8 ma per trattar del ben ch'i' vi trovai,
**Line Inventory:** - しかしそこで見つけた善を論じるために
**Assembly Notes:** - Added Japanese comma “、” to mirror source comma.
**Target Text:** しかしそこで見つけた善を論じるために、
**Source Line:** 9 dirò de l'altre cose ch'i' v'ho scorte.
**Line Inventory:** - 私はそこで見た他のものについて語るだろう
**Assembly Notes:** - Added end‑punctuation “.” to match source.
**Target Text:** 私はそこで見た他のものについて語るだろう.

### Step 5: Self-Correction via Back-Translation & Grammatical Check For each line: verify Step4 Target Text vs Reference Translation + Step1 Locked Meaning; correct within-line only. Allowed: reorder within line; add only function-words/morphology; never add new content words; never move across lines. Punctuation: keep only end punctuation from source; no internal punctuation. Output per line bullets with EXACT fields (no extras): Line #, Target Text, Back-Translation, Reference Translation, Checks, Corrected Target Text (if any). Checks: End Punct <OK|FAIL>, Coverage <OK|FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK|FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <OK|FAIL|N/A>, Hallucination <OK|FAIL> If any FAIL: Corrected Target Text MUST make all checks OK if possible. Comparative Orientation: preserve ordering+degree; treat (A>B) ≡ (B<A) and (A<B) ≡ (B>A); FAIL only if ordering reversed or degree lost. After all lines: if any line still FAILs, output UNVERIFIED with failing Line #s; otherwise do not output UNVERIFIED. Output final Japanese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line #**: 7 **Target Text**: 死はほんの少しだけ苦さが上回る; **Back-Translation**: “Death slightly surpasses bitterness.” **Reference Translation**: “So bitter is it that death is little more.” **Checks**: End Punct <OK> | Coverage <OK> | Meaning Drift <OK> | Comparative Orientation <OK> | Hallucination <OK> **Corrected Target Text**: (none)
- **Line #**: 8 **Target Text**: しかしそこで見つけた善を論じるために、 **Back-Translation**: “However, in order to discuss the good I found there,” **Reference Translation**: “But in order to treat of the good that there I found,” **Checks**: End Punct <OK> | Coverage <OK> | Meaning Drift <OK> | Comparative Orientation <N/A> | Hallucination <OK> **Corrected Target Text**: (none)
- **Line #**: 9 **Target Text**: 私はそこで見た他のものについて語るだろう. **Back-Translation**: “I will probably speak about the other things I saw there.” **Reference Translation**: “I will tell of the other things that I have seen there.” **Checks**: End Punct <OK> | Coverage <OK> | Meaning Drift <FAIL> | Comparative Orientation <N/A> | Hallucination <OK> **Corrected Target Text**: 私はそこで見た他のものについて語ります.
``` 死はほんの少しだけ苦さが上回る; しかしそこで見つけた善を論じるために、 私はそこで見た他のものについて語ります. ```
